coverage.question: What does the business do, for whom, and why do customers choose it?
Who buys, uses and pays; what problems and complaints do they experience?
How does an enquiry become an order, delivered work, an invoice and cash?
What are the main steps, handoffs, approvals and waiting points?
Which departments, roles, skills, reporting lines, salaries and benefits support delivery?
What tangible and intangible resources are owned, leased, licensed or shared?
Which applications, hardware, data and integrations are business-critical?
What recurring costs, commitments, professional fees and avoidable losses exist?
What is overdue, why, and how are disputes and payment allocations handled?
Which suppliers are critical and what bottlenecks do they encounter?
Which obligations, advisers, controls and approvals apply to this scope?
What are the short-, medium- and long-term goals and constraints?

metrics.basis: Management figures for the stated period. Missing inputs or non-positive denominators are unavailable. DSO/DIO/DPO use average balances and matching period flows. CAC uses only the supplied acquisition cost. No causation or assurance is implied.

issues.impact: Cash arrives later and customers need clarifications
issues.name: Late invoicing
issues.problem: Invoices are raised weekly after work is completed

collections.basis: Draft candidates only. Balance must be checked today; disputed, held, not-due and zero balances are excluded. No customer is contacted.
